subject: Plenum Summit 2026 — Plenary slot, exclusivity & activation details
messages:
From: Emma Wright <emma@plenumevents.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver@techcon.io>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Plenum Summit — plenary + exclusivity proposal (package v3 attached)

Hi Nikhil,

Great talking last week — excited about the possibility of Redwood taking the plenary slot at Plenum Summit 2026 (Oct 12). Attached is our updated sponsorship package (Plenum_Sponsorship_Package_v3.pdf) that reflects the new plenary offering. High-level summary: 

- Plenary keynote: 20-minute keynote + 10-minute moderated Q&A on main stage (slot at 10:30am Day 2).
- Category priority: optional platform-category exclusivity (limited to one vendor per category) for an additional fee; gives priority logo placement on stage backdrop and exclusion of direct competitors from main-stage sponsorship.
- Podium rights: logo on lectern, full-stage backdrop, and two 48" step-and-repeat banners flanking the stage.
- Activation: 10x10 demo pod in demo alley with one premium demo rotation (3x 30-minute curated demos across the day).
- Lead capture: integrated lead scanner at demo pod + opt-in badge scan with sponsor dashboard access.
- Deliverables & ops: dedicated tech runner, speaker AV rehearsal 24 hours prior, green room for speaker.

Can you confirm: 1) whether Redwood needs the category exclusivity; 2) any AV or staging constraints we should know about; 3) who will be the speaker(s) and when we can expect bios/logo assets?

If this looks good, I can send the DocuSign for the package and we can lock your slot (we're holding keynote space for two weeks).

Thanks — attaching the package now.

Attachments: Plenum_Sponsorship_Package_v3.pdf

Best,
Emma Wright
Head of Partnerships
Plenum Events
emma@plenumevents.com

--
Plenum Events | 415-555-0123 | https://plenumevents.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Wright <emma@plenumevents.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Plenum Summit — plenary + exclusivity proposal (package v3 attached)

Emma — thanks for the package and the recap. Quick responses inline and a few asks from our side so ops/legal can move fast.

On Tue, Aug 25, 2026 at 9:12 AM Emma Wright <emma@plenumevents.com> wrote:
> Great talking last week — excited about the possibility of Redwood taking the plenary slot at Plenum Summit 2026 (Oct 12). Attached is our updated sponsorship package (Plenum_Sponsorship_Package_v3.pdf) that reflects the new plenary offering. High-level summary:
> ...

We appreciate the offer. A few clarifications before we sign: 
1) Exclusivity scope: we need a precise definition of "platform category" and a list of vendors currently under contract that would be excluded. We are open to exclusivity but only if it's not a blanket ban across all sessions (we prefer main-stage only).
2) Logo placement: please confirm exact artwork dimensions, safe zones, and a mock of stage sightlines (to evaluate visibility from rows 1–12). Our marketing team will need the stage mock to approve.
3) Podium/presence: the lectern/logo placement is fine; we request one additional floor vinyl (3'x2') at the stage entrance for wayfinding.
4) Speaker logistics: Redwood expects to send 1 speaker + 1 product PM who will demo. We need AV specs for live demo (mic type, laptop inputs, AV tech support for local GPU demos).
5) Lead capture & privacy: outline the lead data fields we can collect and confirm whether opt-in is double opt-in for GDPR.
6) Timing & payment: please confirm the contract deadline to lock the slot and the 50% deposit vs. full prepayment options.

Looping in Lauren (events ops) and Kimberly (marketing/legal) to surface any internal constraints. 

Next steps from our side: if you can share a stage mock, a competitor list for exclusivity, and the DocuSign link today we can review and send redlines.

Thanks —
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Partnerships & Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0789

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Logo_Guidelines.zip (will provide once we have final stage specs)

From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Plenum Summit — plenary + exclusivity proposal (internal)

Nikhil / Kim — drafting quick ops/legal checklist and suggested redlines before we send to Emma. See notes below; I attached a doc with inline redlines (Sponsorship_Redlines_2026.docx).

Key asks / recommended redlines:
- Narrow exclusivity: convert "category exclusivity" to "priority competitor exclusion on main stage" and define excluded companies by name. Push to limit to direct platform competitors only (e.g., companies offering hosted LLM inference endpoints) — reject broader "AI vendor" definitions.
- Measurement: require sponsor dashboard access for lead counts within 48 hours post-event and sample CSV export.
- AV & demo: require a dedicated A/V tech for our demo slot with a wired HDMI + Thunderbolt path and the ability to stage a local laptop with GPU passthrough (we may also bring a small eGPU box).
- Signage/placement: require detailed sightline mock (diagram) and commit to logo placement at sizes we approve. Add a clause: "Sponsor may request adjustments to backdrop logo sizing up to 10 business days before event."
- Cancellation & force majeure: require pro-rated refund for event cancellation >60 days out; credit rather than refund for 30–60 days.
- Photo/recording rights: explicitly permit Redwood to record the keynote and reuse clip for marketing; require prior written notice for any third-party resell of footage.

Ops asks:
- Confirm electrical power at demo pod (120V/20A) and exact footprint.
- Clarify badge scanning data retention policy and GDPR opt-in flow (must be explicit consent).
- Send us stage dimensions, backdrop artwork template, and mock by Aug 28 so we can provide logo assets in time.

If we want exclusivity it needs to be priced with a written competitor list and expiration (i.e., doesn't extend into other partner tiers). Otherwise I'd advise taking the plenary slot without exclusivity and pushing for priority signage + a competitor-free demo rotation window.

I'll attach the redline doc. If legal wants to take lead on wording I can hand over after edits.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Events & Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Sponsorship_Redlines_2026.docx

From: Emma Wright <emma@plenumevents.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver@techcon.io>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Plenum Summit — plenary + exclusivity proposal (package v3 attached)

Nikhil / Lauren — thanks for the thoughtful notes, and for the redlines doc, Lauren. Quick update and compromises from our side so we can move to contract: 

1) Exclusivity: happy to convert to "priority competitor exclusion on main stage". We'll provide the list of vendors currently contracted by EOD and we will limit the exclusion to direct hosted inference platform competitors. The exclusivity term will be main-stage only and expires 30 days after the event.

2) Logo & sightlines: attached is a stage mock and backdrop template; we'll send the high-res mock separately (we're including it in the production packet). We can commit to the additional floor vinyl at stage entrance.

3) AV & demo: dedicated A/V tech will be assigned for your demo and we'll provide HDMI + Thunderbolt adapters on-site. For GPU passthrough please submit the detailed requirements — we can allocate a technician for a run-through 24 hours prior.

4) Lead capture & privacy: lead CSV will be available within 48 hours; badge opt-in will be single opt-in at the time of scan but we'll include a GDPR-compliant consent language on the badge registration page. If you require double opt-in we can discuss alternate flows.

5) Recording & reuse: Plenum will provide sponsor-approved raw footage for sponsor use; we will not resell footage to third parties without written consent.

6) Timeline & contract: we can hold the plenary slot until Aug 30 pending signature. I'll send a DocuSign for the main package with two optional addenda (exclusivity addendum and additional demo rotation addendum). DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/some-sample-link/ABC123

Please send logo files (SVG + PNG) and speaker bios to partners@plenumevents.com by Aug 30 to guarantee inclusion in the printed program. If you want exclusivity we'll include the confirmed competitor list in the addendum and show the final fee on the DocuSign.

Attachments: stage_mock_v1.pdf (sent separately), Plenum production packet link (in DocuSign).

We can finalize once we have your go/no-go on exclusivity and the assets.

Best,
Emma Wright
Head of Partnerships
Plenum Events
emma@plenumevents.com
